svg.title: The casino control plane, its brands and a liquidity pool
svg.desc: One hub cluster and three spoke clusters. The hub is eitheror's own ankka installation: its gateway, control plane and operator, and the realm every spoke's installation trusts, where eitheror staff sign in. On it runs one project, casino-control-plane, with four services: console, eitheror's backoffice over every installation, brand and module, whose writes go to the brand that owns the entity; entitlements, the home of the entitlement entities that say which modules a brand runs, which pool it joins and what it is billed; releases, the home of the release entities that carry module versions and the channel each brand follows; and mirrors, follower copies of every brand's module entities, read only, with any write forwarded to the brand. Beside them, fleet and billing views rebuilt from the mirrored journals and the hub's own, holding nothing personal because players never leave their brand, and the project's Postgres with the hub-homed entities and the mirrored copies. An eitheror admin reaches the console through the hub's gateway. Each spoke cluster has its own ankka installation, trusting the hub realm, and a replication link dialled outward from the spoke: module entities go up to the hub, entitlement and release entities come down. The first spoke is a shared cluster with one installation hosting two brands and a pool. Each brand is one project: a core of wallet, players, kyc, responsible-gambling, payouts and modules, where modules homes the brand's module entity and deploys the enabled modules through the local control plane; then the enabled modules, here casino (game providers, rounds and bets) and predictions (forecasts and web in the brand, markets and exchange from the pool). Each of these two brands' wallets holds one clearing account, a non-player account owned by the pool and the pool's counterparty in that wallet. The pool, pool-north, is a third project on the same installation: markets, one catalogue and one price for every member; exchange, one book per outcome, where an order carries its brand and player; clearing, where every move is local, between a player and their own brand's clearing account, the pool keeps a net per brand and the operator settles the net; gates, which asks may-bet and kyc of the player's brand over grants; and membership, an entitlement at the hub, limited to brands on the same installation. Arrows from clearing reach the clearing account in each member brand's wallet. A brand operator reaches their own brand's backoffice, and players their brand's app, through the shared installation's gateway. The second spoke is a dedicated cluster for one licensee, brand acme, with the same core and only the casino module: no predictions, because its entitlement does not name it. The third spoke is a dedicated cluster for brand nord, with the core, casino, and predictions in the project with its own book and no pool. Outside, the deployments repository ankka-modules-deployments holds each cluster, its ankka version and the spoke template; Flux on each cluster pulls it; it carries platform versions only, never a module.
